title: CardDemo – Java Transformation Status
subtitle: One row per COBOL module · links point to the generated Java microservice source

modules.name: CBACT01C
modules.description: Reads all account records sequentially and distributes data into multiple output files (flat, array, variable-length).

modules.name: CBACT02C
modules.description: Reads and prints all credit card records from the card master file for reporting or audit purposes.

modules.name: CBACT03C
modules.description: Read and print all card-to-account cross-reference records from the cross-reference file.

modules.name: CBACT04C
modules.description: Computes and posts monthly interest charges and fees to credit card accounts based on transaction category balances.

modules.name: COACCT01
modules.description: Retrieve and return credit card account details in response to incoming service requests received via IBM MQ.

modules.name: COACTUPC
modules.description: Accepts and processes updates to credit card account and customer information entered by bank staff through an online screen.

modules.name: COACTVWC
modules.description: Allows bank staff to view the full details of a credit card account by entering an account number.

modules.name: COADM01C
modules.description: Presents and manages the administrative navigation menu for authorised admin users.

modules.name: COUSR00C
modules.description: Provides administrators with a paginated list of all system users, allowing them to select a user for update or deletion.

modules.name: COUSR01C
modules.description: Add a new Regular or Admin user account to the CardDemo system's user security file.

modules.name: COUSR02C
modules.description: Allow administrators to look up and update an existing user account's details in the user security file.

modules.name: COUSR03C
modules.description: Allow administrators to look up and permanently delete an existing user account from the user security file.

modules.name: CBPAUP0C
modules.description: Cleanup of expired, outstanding authorization messages from the credit card authorization database.

modules.name: COPAUA0C
modules.description: Real-time credit card authorization decision: checks incoming requests from an MQ queue and approves or declines.

modules.name: COPAUS0C
modules.description: Overview display of pending authorization messages for a credit card account with scrolling and drill-down.

modules.name: COPAUS1C
modules.description: Detail view of a pending credit card authorization message with the option to mark transactions as fraudulent.

modules.name: COPAUS2C
modules.description: Persistence of a fraud report or fraud de-marking for a credit card authorization transaction.

modules.name: COSGN00C
modules.description: Authenticates users logging into CardDemo and routes them to the appropriate menu based on their user type.

modules.name: DBUNLDGS
modules.description: Unload of outstanding authorization data from the IMS database into sequential GSAM output files.

modules.name: PAUDBLOD
modules.description: Loading of outstanding authorization data from sequential files into the IMS database for recovery or initial population.

modules.name: PAUDBUNL
modules.description: Unload all pending authorization data from the IMS database into sequential output files for archiving or backup.

modules.name: COCRDLIC
modules.description: Displays a paginated list of credit cards to bank staff, filtered by account or showing all cards for admins.

modules.name: COCRDSLC
modules.description: Allows bank staff to search for and display the details of a specific credit card by account or card number.

modules.name: COCRDUPC
modules.description: Allows bank staff to update credit card details (cardholder name, expiry date, active status) through a confirmation workflow.

modules.name: CBCUS01C
modules.description: Sequentially reads and prints all customer records from the customer master file for reporting or audit purposes.

modules.name: COMEN01C
modules.description: Presents and manages the main navigation menu for regular (non-admin) users of the CardDemo system.

modules.name: CBSTM03A
modules.description: Generates periodic credit card account statements from transaction data, in plain text and HTML formats.

modules.name: CBSTM03B
modules.description: Reusable batch file-access subroutine providing controlled read access to transaction, card, customer, and account files.

modules.name: CBTRN03C
modules.description: Generates a formatted transaction detail report for credit card transactions within a date range, with subtotals and grand totals.

modules.name: CORPT00C
modules.description: Allows staff to request and submit transaction reports (monthly, yearly, or custom range) from an online CICS screen.

modules.name: CBTRN01C
modules.description: Reads daily credit card transactions and validates each by verifying the card number and resolving it to a customer account.

modules.name: CBTRN02C
modules.description: Validates and posts daily credit card transactions, updating account balances and routing invalid transactions to a rejection file.

modules.name: COBIL00C
modules.description: Enables cardholders to pay their credit card account balance in full through an online bill payment transaction.

modules.name: COBTUPDT
modules.description: Maintains the Transaction Type reference table by processing a sequential input file to add, update, or delete type codes.

modules.name: COTRN00C
modules.description: Displays a paginated list of credit card transactions, allowing users to browse and select individual transactions for detail viewing.

modules.name: COTRN01C
modules.description: Displays the full details of a single credit card transaction retrieved from the TRANSACT file by Transaction ID.

modules.name: COTRN02C
modules.description: Allows authorised users to manually add a new credit card transaction record to the CardDemo transaction ledger.

modules.name: COTRTLIC
modules.description: Interactive screen for administrators to browse, search, and initiate updates or deletions of Transaction Type reference data.

modules.name: COTRTUPC
modules.description: Interactive CICS screen for administrators to add, update, or delete Transaction Type reference data records.

modules.name: CBEXPORT
modules.description: Exports complete customer, account, card, cross-reference, and transaction data into a structured migration file.

modules.name: CBIMPORT
modules.description: Imports and normalises customer, account, card, and transaction data from a branch migration export file.

modules.name: COBSWAIT
modules.description: Introduces a controlled pause into batch processing workflows for a specified duration in centiseconds.

modules.name: CODATE01
modules.description: Provides current date and time information to requesting services via IBM MQ, acting as a centralised date/time service.

modules.name: CSUTLDTC
modules.description: Validates whether a given date string is a legitimate calendar date according to a specified format.
